title: Basis for the Agency Service Charge Settled on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
The agency service charge is owed once for every traveller the booking carries, and where the booking's lines cover fewer travellers than it carries the charge is owed for the travellers the lines do not yet cover.

## 1. While the booking stands as a hold

A booking that stands as an uncollected hold carries that charge for as long as the hold stands, and it is not ticketed while any part of the collection is still outstanding.

## 2. The unit and the quantities

2.1 **The unit.** The unit the charge is taken at is the fare brand's own agency service fee, as scheduled for the Air Ticket Fare Brands brand the booking is held in.
2.2 **The travellers not yet covered.** The travellers the booking carries, less the agency service lines already standing on it, and never fewer than none.
2.3 **The programme's billing.** The programme's billing is read over the current billing period alone, that is over the last 1 month.
2.4 **The volume rebate.** No volume rebate is taken off the gross charge: the rebate stands at 0 percent.
2.5 **The transaction overage.** No transaction overage is added: the addition stands at 0.00 USD.
2.6 **The lead-time loading.** No lead-time loading is added: the loading stands at 0.00 USD.
2.7 **The conversion markup.** No conversion markup is applied: the markup stands at 0 percent.

## 3. How the figure assembles

The unit and the travellers not yet covered are multiplied together into the gross charge; the volume rebate acts on that gross charge alone, the overage and lead-time additions are then added to the rebated figure, and the conversion markup acts last, on the sum of the rebated figure and those two additions.

The sum settled never falls below zero, and the result is rounded to the nearest cent.

## 4. Worked figure, on hypothetical inputs

A booking carrying 3 travellers with 1 agency service line already standing on it, held in a brand whose scheduled agency service fee is a hypothetical 24.95 USD.

| Step | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| the travellers not yet covered: 3 carried, less 1 line already standing | 2 |
| the unit of 24.95 USD taken for each of them, giving the gross charge | 49.90 USD |
| the volume rebate of 0 percent acting on the gross charge | 49.90 USD |
| the overage of 0.00 USD and the lead-time loading of 0.00 USD added to it | 49.90 USD |
| the conversion markup of 0 percent acting on that sum | 49.90 USD |
| held at nothing were it lower, and rounded to the nearest cent | 49.90 USD |

Where the same booking already carries 3 agency service lines against its 3 travellers, the travellers not yet covered come to none, and the sum settled is 0.00 USD.
